Materials/textures: Realistic porous pale stone, aged bronze trim, believable shelves and varied real book spines with no readable text.
Constraints: Photorealistic architectural photography, polished and dignified, no people, no readable text, no watermark, no logo, no app UI, no buttons, no red borders, no comic covers. Avoid strong contrast or saturated colors so the background does not compete with covers. Preserve architectural realism and enough shadow detail.
